ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) field with approximately 8-12% high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark background across both lobes with high-contrast, roughly circular white clusters (mottling) distributed semi-randomly; higher concentration of high-intensity pixels observed in the medial regions near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 140 degrees between the inner lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude, irregular serrations (1-4 pixel depth) forming a jagged continuous boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) ranging from 3 to 15 pixels in diameter, distributed across the dark ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive focal scarring appearing as white circular marks (rosettes) across the entire visible fluke surface.
